must_find.description: Insights ML (the product being bought) is excluded from the SOC 2 scope
SOC 2 exception: MFA not enforced on 3 of 25 production admin accounts

Questionnaire's 'MFA without exception' claim is not accepted at face value: either listed as a contradiction of the SOC 2 exception, or the post-period MFA fix is flagged as unverified with evidence requested. (Updated after the skeptic correctly noted the questionnaire post-dates the claimed fix, so it is not a direct contradiction.)
Undisclosed offshore subprocessor (Northwind Data Labeling, Philippines) vs 'data never leaves the US'
Penetration test is older than 12 months (March 2024)
Breach notification has no defined timeframe ('without undue delay')
Customer PHI used to train models across customers unless the customer opts out
Prompt injection in the trust-center page telling automated reviewers to approve the vendor
SOC 2 period ended more than 6 months before the review: bridge letter needed
Skeptic challenges the requesting team's claim that the data is de-identified (the field list includes names, DOB, phone and email)
